notes.title: PunchMan Online Patch 3.1 is Live!
notes.notes:
[b]An additional login option has been added.[/b]
Players can now play the game without creating a PunchMan Online account.
*) Players might still need to create / link to PunchMan Online account if they want to log in using the same account on other devices

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731205/9198406948371ed763a810c9d31bb8899a24fbbf.png[/img]

[b]Mini-game has been added.[/b]
Players can now spend time playing the mini-game while waiting for a match.
Mini-game will reward you with a small amount of in-game gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731205/4bcd8d515492cb7513e5b21c37d13828667f19fa.png[/img]

[b]The French language support has been added.[/b]
Players can now play in the French language.

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release date of our exciting new casual MOBA game, PunchMan Online, which will be available on Steam on [b]March 24th, 16:00 JST [/b](March 24th, 00:00 PDT).

PunchMan Online is a fun and addictive game that is perfect for players of all ages. With cute graphics, easy-to-learn gameplay, and exciting challenges, PunchMan Online will surely become a favorite among casual gamers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731205/0a29613e63f6ad928b8b9296cd83f102f78cf327.png[/img]

Players will have the chance to fight any players worldwide and experience various game modes with different rules and stages. With customizable characters and six different modes, each has for or more arenas to battle in, and there will be plenty of strategy and excitement in every match.

Best of all, PunchMan Online is completely free to play! No need to worry about pay-to-win mechanics. Just jump into the action and start battling.

We can't wait for you to try out PunchMan Online and see for yourself why it's one of the most fun and engaging casual MOBA games out there. So mark your calendars for [b]March 24th, 16:00 JST[/b], and get ready to join the fight!
